deployments_detail.use: 'Taishin War God' (台新戰神) AI fraud/anti-scam model that monitors transactions in real time to flag suspicious activity and high-risk accounts; paired with an ATM monitoring system that alerts law enforcement. Part of the 'War God Project' MOU with the Taipei District Prosecutors Office. [Self-built (Taishin)]
deployments_detail.value: Blocked 612 high-risk accounts and prevented ~NT$70 million in fraud losses in 2024; stated accuracy over 50%

deployments_detail.use: Responsible-AI validation collaboration: Taishin Bank partnered with OneDegree Global to validate and stress-test its 'Taishin Brain' AI system for compliance with Taiwan's Guidelines for the Use of AI in the Financial Industry (AI governance, security and privacy). [OneDegree Global]

'Rose' intelligent customer-service chatbot: 24/7 conversational AI across web, mobile app, LINE and Facebook for account/credit-card inquiries, bill payment, FX rates, loan/card applications, with hand-off to human agents; originally built on Intumit SmartRobot (Microsoft Azure AI), now re-architected on the self-built Taishin Brain LLM for omnichannel service. [Intumit SmartRobot (Microsoft Azure AI); migrated to self-built Taishin Brain LLM]
deployments_detail.value: Reported ability to fully answer up to 98% of customer questions

deployments_detail.use: 'Taishin Corporate AI Smart Assistant' (台新法金AI智慧通): generative-AI customer-service assistant embedded in the corporate/GB2B internet banking (法人金流) platform, giving business clients real-time text and voice explanations of cash-management services and product solutions. [Self-built (Taishin Brain)]

Generative-AI virtual customer-service agents: photorealistic avatar agents combining LLM with voice-to-text, text-to-voice and face recognition to deliver wealth-management and credit-card product recommendations, launched publicly at the 2024 Taipei FinTech expo / went live end of 2024. [Self-built (Taishin Brain, multimodal)]

AI robotic form-filling assistant at Taishin Life (life insurance) that lets customers complete forms via conversation, plus a consumer-facing GPT-4o + MBTI credit-card recommendation experience at Taishin Bank shown at the 2024 FinTech expo. [OpenAI GPT-4o (for the MBTI card experience); Taishin AI robot]
AI-generated corporate credit reports cutting preparation time from 21 hours to 4 hours (partnership with Moody's)

Internal generative-AI knowledge-management platform and employee AI test/enablement environment ('AI Concept Hall' / 人工智慧概念館): lets staff query internal documents via GenAI to speed up back-office work, plus 'tool brain' models handling single tasks such as image processing; supported by AI/data literacy programs as Taishin scales AI internally. [Self-built (Taishin Brain / tool-brain models)]
Built proprietary LLM "Taishin Brain" powering smart customer service and productivity tools; deployed 16 NVIDIA H100 GPUs (~NT$30M)

Self-built financial-domain large language model 'Taishin Brain' (台新腦, later 台新新光腦), a ~37-billion-parameter Traditional Chinese LLM plus smaller 'tool brain' models, trained on Taishin's own data and run on-premise with NVIDIA GPUs (cloud used for training). Serves as the core platform underpinning chatbots, credit analysis, marketing and internal apps across bank, life-insurance and securities units. [Self-built (NVIDIA GPUs for compute)]

AI-assisted corporate credit-investigation / credit-memo platform: Taishin adopted Moody's Credit Memo with GenAI to automate data consolidation from dozens of sources and draft credit analysis reports, augmenting relationship managers. [Moody's (Credit Memo / Lending Suite) + Taishin Brain]
deployments_detail.value: Credit report production cut from 20 hours to 4 hours (5x faster); up to 50% time savings in parts of credit analysis; corporate-lending manpower cost reduced 3.4%

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven personalized digital marketing ('People Centric Model'): a three-stage pipeline that integrates multi-source data, builds a customer-preference recommendation system, and uses generative AI to produce customized marketing content, with PowerBI tracking effectiveness. [Self-built (Taishin Brain) + Microsoft PowerBI]
